revisions.author: FID Rayhan
revisions.description: Upload files LLM9Q910 / LLM9Q880 instead of the screen steps; source = TB_H_PART_CANDIDATE_STG_SYNC only; SEND_SEQ order 1 / 2 / 3 (22-Nov).

objective: To make the cross dock master of AP POLE equal to NSP by an RPA that uploads files (22-Nov): Cross Dock Kanban Part Master (LLM9Q910) and Export Customer Cross Dock Master (LLM9Q880), filled from the stored templates.
Source data: only TB_H_PART_CANDIDATE_STG_SYNC (read-only DB user), rows of the run ID passed by [Sync] / [Re-send last Sync]. NSP has reduced the rows and set SEND_SEQ before the bot starts.

Order: SEND_SEQ 1 Export (parts whose Max goes down) -> 2 Kanban -> 3 Export (every other part); Current period first, then Next. AP POLE checks every row: total Max Shipping Box (RCS) of the part <= Max Shipping Box Qty.
The bot writes nothing back to NSP; the result comes by the notification e-mail.

steps: NSP starts the flow with the run ID after [Sync] / [Re-send last Sync] (the staging is already updated). Write LOG1. The whole run is inside one try-catch.

steps.text: Read TB_H_PART_CANDIDATE_STG_SYNC (read-only DB user): rows with APPOLE_SYNC_RUN_ID = run ID and SEND_SEQ not NULL.
children: Kanban rows (SEND_SEQ 2): one row per part + period; Pcs/Case and Max Case/Day = NEW_VALUE of the latest row with APPOLE_SYNC_STATUS 1 of each field (this run or an earlier one), so the pair is complete when only one field changed.
Export rows (SEND_SEQ 1 / 3): Max Shipping Box (RCS) = NEW_VALUE (0 for DELETE).

steps.text: Fill the stored templates: one file per period + SEND_SEQ, name <template>_<run ID>_<period>_<SEND_SEQ>.xls (e.g. LLM9Q880_20261127100000_202611_1.xls). A file without rows is not made.
children: Inside an Export file: per part the rows going down / deleted first, then up / added (AP POLE checks row by row).

steps.text: Upload the files one at a time in the order of their names (Current period first, then Next) and wait for each result. Write LOG3 per file.
children: File 1 (Export, only parts whose Max goes down) -> file 2 (Kanban) -> file 3 (Export, every other part).

steps.text: Any error (try-catch): stop at the failed file, write LOG4. The files already uploaded stay in AP POLE; the other files wait for [Re-send last Sync].

steps: Send the notification e-mail (SUCCESS / FAILED), write LOG6 and LOG2. The bot writes nothing to NSP.

items: Procurement maintains the Kanban Crossdock Master and the D/S team the Export Crossdock Master on XD01; XD05 makes the Next period on day D. Every value change is a row of TB_H_PART_CANDIDATE_STG_SYNC (refer XD01 5.24).
The D/S team clicks [Sync]: NSP reduces the Non Sync rows of the Current and Next period (first OLD / last NEW per key), sets SEND_SEQ, the run ID and LAST_SYNC_DATE_APPOLE, then starts this bot.
Decisions and simulation: deliverables/function_list_v2/erd/proposal_staging_sync (Summary_Staging_Sync_Decisions.md, simulation/Full_Sync_Flow_Simulation.xlsx).

rows: EXPORT rows of a part whose Max Case/Day goes down (destinations lowered first)
Every KANBAN change and new part (Pcs/Case and Max in one row)
EXPORT rows of every other part: Max up, new part, no KANBAN row (moves, deletes, Inactive)

items: File name <template>_<run ID>_<period>_<SEND_SEQ>.xls; one file per period + SEND_SEQ; Current first, then Next. A file without rows is not made.
AP POLE checks every row: total Max Shipping Box (RCS) of the part <= Max Shipping Box Qty. Inside an Export file the rows of a part going down / deleted come first, then up / added.
Delete of a Buyer-PD = Max Shipping Box (RCS) 0 (the row stays in AP POLE with 0). An Inactive part stays in the Kanban with its Buyer-PD 0; in the following months it has no Export row.
Rows of the run: APPOLE_SYNC_RUN_ID = run ID and SEND_SEQ not NULL (Superseded rows and keys ending on their first value have no SEND_SEQ).
Kanban row: Pcs/Case and Max Case/Day = NEW_VALUE of the latest row with APPOLE_SYNC_STATUS 1 of each field for the part + period (this run or an earlier one; XD05 always writes both on day D).
Part Name from the staging (PART_NAME column).
Queries: deliverables/function_list_v2/erd/proposal_staging_sync/sql/staging_sync_queries.sql (Kanban file, Export files).
The whole run is in one try-catch. Any error (login, upload screen, AP POLE error of a row, timeout) stops the run at that file.

Files uploaded before the error stay in AP POLE. The D/S team clicks [Re-send last Sync]: the files of the last run are made and uploaded again in the same order (the values are set, so a repeat is safe).
NSP does not receive the result (no response); the staging stays Sync. The e-mail tells SUCCESS / FAILED.
The cloud flow of the RPA sends one email per run of XD07 (AP POLE), so the user knows the result without opening NSP.
One email per target: XD06 (GTOPAS) and XD07 (AP POLE) run as separate bots, so a [Sync] gives two emails.
One email per run: the retries of the same run do not send an email; only the final result does.

tables.name: TB_H_PART_CANDIDATE_STG_SYNC
tables.description: Staging of every value change of the Kanban / Export Crossdock Master for the sync to AP POLE (XD07) and GTOPAS (XD06) (22-Nov). Inserted by XD01 (screen), XD02 / XD03 (upload) and XD05 in the same transaction as the master update; updated only by [Sync], [Re-send last Sync] and the Period Rollover. The RPA reads only this table. TB_H_PART_CANDIDATE (screen history) is kept as it is.
columns: Running number (identity): order of the changes
Part number (NSP format, with "-"); FK1 (PART_NO, PERIOD) -> TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE
Part Name copied from TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE at the insert (Part Name of the Kanban upload file)
Calculation period YYYYMM; Effective Month / Year of the AP POLE upload
Status of the part in this period when the row is written (Active / Inactive). Inactive: the part stays in the AP POLE Kanban, its Export rows are DELETE with NEW_VALUE 0
KANBAN = parent (Kanban Crossdock Master), EXPORT = destination (Export Crossdock Master)
EXPORT only: destination code. No FK (a DELETE row points to a removed destination)
Value before the change; NULL on ADD
Value after the change; 0 on DELETE
Upload of the Kanban or Export Excel (Log); NULL when SOURCE is not UPLOAD
0 = Non Sync (default), 1 = Sync, 2 = Superseded (an earlier row of the same key, not sent). The part + period is AP POLE Non Sync while it has a row with 0
Time of the [Sync] that sent the row to AP POLE (status 1 and 2); Last Sent AP POLE = latest value

Upload file: 1 = Export (LLM9Q880) before the Kanban file, only for a part whose Max goes down; 2 = Kanban (LLM9Q910); 3 = Export after the Kanban file (every other part). Set at [Sync] on the last row of each key; NULL for 2 and for a key that ends on its first value
AP POLE run ID YYYYMMDDHHMMSS; [Re-send last Sync] takes the rows of the last run
NULL = not for GTOPAS (KANBAN rows, EXPORT EDIT). 0 = Non Sync: EXPORT ADD / DELETE (destination appears / disappears). 1 = Sync: [Sync] for the Current period, the Period Rollover for the new period
Time of the [Sync] / Period Rollover that sent the row to GTOPAS; Last Sent GTOPAS = latest value
GTOPAS run ID ([Sync], [Re-send last Sync] or the Period Rollover)
User of the save / upload, or XD05BATCH
Time of the insert (same transaction as the master update)
User of [Sync] / [Re-send last Sync], XD05BATCH for the Period Rollover
